summary: A cancelled run no longer cancels a finally step whose exec is still being launched

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: A local process with no runtime observation now counts as stopped only when its recorded state says it ended, as a remote one already did. Finally steps whose processes exited are still cancelled at once.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
